title: Deprecated Card
description:
[blue]This card was removed in a recent update.[/blue]
Draw 1 card.
Remove this from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
notes: Placeholder card used internally when a card has been removed or deprecated from the game. Cannot be upgraded (MaxUpgradeLevel = 0). Not displayed in the card library. When played: draws 1 card, then removes itself from the deck.
